description:
Use this when the user wants text, a sticker, a sound, B-roll or another video on a clip: "add a title that
says NO WAY", "a whoosh at 4 seconds", "put my reaction in the corner" (pip_clip_id; green_screen keys out
its background). B-roll (stock, Premium) goes in a call of its own; names from edit_catalog.
Not for: the clip's captions or music (edit_clip). Undoable. Costs no Horizon Units. Returns job_id.

broll_at_seconds.description: Seconds into the clip B-roll starts; -1 = not by time.

broll_layout.description: Half of the frame B-roll fills: top or bottom.

broll_line.description: Words the speaker says where B-roll goes.

broll_search.description: What the B-roll shows; empty = taken from broll_line.

green_screen.description: Remove this colour from it: green, a colour name or hex like #00FF00.

pip_clip_id.description: Video to show on top (picture-in-picture): a clip id from list_clips or a project id from list_projects.

pip_position.description: top-right, top-left, bottom-right, bottom-left or center.

pip_seconds.description: Length in seconds; 0 = until its video or the clip ends.

pip_size.description: Width in percent of the frame, 10-100; 0 = 40.

pip_start_seconds.description: Seconds into the clip it starts.

sound_at_seconds.description: Seconds into the clip the sound plays, e.g. 4.0.

sound_effect.description: Sound effect name or id from edit_catalog.

sticker.description: Sticker name or id from edit_catalog, or the emoji itself.

sticker_at_seconds.description: Seconds into the clip the sticker appears.

sticker_position.description: top, middle or bottom; empty = middle.

sticker_seconds.description: Sticker duration in seconds; omit for 2.

text.description: Text to show, e.g. "NO WAY". One line per line of the style.

text_end_seconds.description: Seconds into the clip the text ends; 0 = 3 s after start.

text_start_seconds.description: Seconds into the clip the text appears, e.g. 2.5.

name: add_to_clip
title: Add to a clip
